tools.name: check_headshot_photo
tools.description: Use this when the user wants technical checks of one professional profile or job-application photo from a public HTTPS URL or base64. Maximum 8 MB; image_url is recommended. Base64 above roughly 150 KB may exceed the Worker CPU budget. Auto mode resizes through an optional Images binding for pixel m

tools.name: get_headshot_photo_requirements
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a technical headshot checklist and crop recommendations for LinkedIn, XING or job applications. Returns static recommendations, not official platform upload limits; no image input or external network access. No persistent changes; operational call metadata is logged. Do

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_headshot_photo · Private data: check_headshot_photo · Public sink: get_headshot_photo_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_headshot_photo · Private data: check_headshot_photo · Public sink: get_headshot_photo_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
